# ChatGPT
> ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI product for chatting, creating, researching, and getting help across web, desktop, and mobile.

ChatGPT combines general-purpose AI assistance with product features for writing, coding, analysis, image generation, voice interaction, and team collaboration. Its public site includes product information, app access, release notes, and help resources.

## Core Product
- [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/): Main ChatGPT app entry point for conversations, tools, and account access.
- [Download ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/download): Official download page for desktop and mobile ChatGPT apps.
- [Desktop Apps](https://chatgpt.com/desktop): Overview of ChatGPT desktop app availability and features.
- [Mac App](https://chatgpt.com/mac): Information about the ChatGPT app for macOS.
- [Windows App](https://chatgpt.com/windows): Information about the ChatGPT app for Windows.
- [Mobile Apps](https://chatgpt.com/mobile): Overview of ChatGPT on iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.

## Plans and Business
- [Pricing](https://chatgpt.com/pricing): Plan comparison for Free, Plus, Pro, Team, and enterprise offerings.
- [Business](https://chatgpt.com/business): ChatGPT for organizations with admin, security, and collaboration features.
- [Enterprise](https://chatgpt.com/enterprise): Enterprise-focused overview for large-scale deployment, governance, and support.
- [Education](https://chatgpt.com/education): ChatGPT offerings and capabilities for schools, students, and educators.
- [Teams](https://chatgpt.com/team): Team plan overview for collaborative use within smaller organizations.

## Features
- [Canvas](https://chatgpt.com/features/canvas): Workspace feature for drafting, editing, and iterating on longer-form content.
- [Projects](https://chatgpt.com/features/projects): Organize chats, files, and work into reusable project spaces.
- [Tasks](https://chatgpt.com/features/tasks): Task-oriented workflows and assistance within ChatGPT.
- [Voice](https://chatgpt.com/features/voice): Voice conversation capabilities for speaking with ChatGPT naturally.
- [Image Generation](https://chatgpt.com/features/images): Create and edit images directly within ChatGPT.
- [File Uploads](https://chatgpt.com/features/files): Use documents and uploaded files as context for analysis and answers.

## Use Cases
- [Writing](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/writing): Examples of using ChatGPT for drafting, editing, and rewriting text.
- [Coding](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/coding): Examples of using ChatGPT for programming help and code generation.
- [Learning](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/learning): Examples of tutoring, explanation, and study support workflows.
- [Productivity](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/productivity): Examples of planning, summarization, and everyday work assistance.
- [Research](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/research): Examples of gathering, synthesizing, and exploring information with ChatGPT.
- [Data Analysis](https://chatgpt.com/use-cases/data-analysis): Examples of analyzing datasets, tables, and uploaded files.
